environment.dependencies: pandas 3.0.5, numpy 2.5.3, pyarrow not installed; parquet reader mini_parquet.read_parquet_pure_python

split: No fitting. Descriptive summary pooled over all eligible BFMD transitions from the 08 match-level train/validation/test splits; counts per split are in metrics.json.

metrics.sum_L_over_sum_d: Total smoothed path length L divided by total straight hit-to-hit displacement d (unitless)
metrics.mean_excess_short_m: Mean L - d (m) over transitions with d <= short_distance_threshold_m
metrics.energy_equivalent_of_short_excess_J_per_: mean_excess_short_m x energy_coefficient_j_per_kg_m (J/kg); a scale illustration, not a metabolic estimate
metrics.excess_by_*.csv: n, mean d, mean L, mean/median L - d and sum L / sum d per distance bin, role and shot

limitations: Tracking-proxy kinematics from 08 (bbox ground proxy, 30 fps); the excess may include tracking noise. No uncertainty interval is computed. No metabolic, fatigue or win-probability validation. The transfer model, D_tp and new transition costs are not part of this run.
